events.description: A new feature was added to Service Control for additional quota policy checks; the code change and binary release were rolled out region by region, but the new code path was never exercised because it required a policy change to trigger it. A red-button to disable that serving path was included.

A policy change with unintended blank fields was inserted into the regional Spanner tables used by Service Control and replicated globally within seconds; Service Control exercised the new code path, hit a null pointer, and binaries entered a crash loop globally in each regional deployment.
Within 2 minutes of the start of the incident, the Site Reliability Engineering team began triaging.
Multiple GCP products began experiencing service issues (as later stated in the 11:46 status update).
Within 10 minutes of the start of the incident, the cause was identified and the red-button to disable the serving path was being put in place.
The red-button was ready to roll out, approximately 25 minutes from the start of the incident.
Within 40 minutes of the incident, the red-button rollout was completed and recovery began across regions, starting with the smaller ones.

In larger regions such as us-central1, restarting Service Control tasks created a herd effect that overloaded the underlying Spanner table; the team throttled task creation and routed traffic to multi-regional databases.
The first incident report was posted to Cloud Service Health, delayed because that infrastructure was itself down due to the outage.
Status update: multiple GCP products experiencing service issues beginning at 10:51; engineering investigating; no workaround.
Status update: issue recovered in some locations; no ETA on full mitigation.
Status update: all locations except us-central1 fully recovered; us-central1 mostly recovered.
Status update: underlying dependency recovered in all locations except us-central1.
Status update: infrastructure recovered in all regions except us-central1; issues continued in us-central1 and multi-region/us.
Status update: mitigation implemented for us-central1 and multi-region/us; signs of recovery.
Status update: most Google Cloud products confirmed full service recovery; a few services still had residual impact.
Status update: most Google Cloud products fully recovered as of 13:45; residual impact noted for Dataflow backlog, Vertex AI Online Prediction, and Personalized Service Health.
Status update: Dataflow backlog cleared in all regions except us-central1.
Status update: Personalized Service Health resolved; Dataflow fully resolved as of 17:10; only remaining impact was Vertex AI Online Prediction.
Status update: Vertex AI Model Garden 5xx errors resolved as of 17:05; serving normal except europe-west1 and asia-southeast1.
Status update: Vertex AI Online Prediction fully recovered as of 18:18; all services fully recovered.
